question: How many bananas could Elon Musk buy with his entire 2025 fortune?
explainer: Forbes put Musk's fortune at about $342 billion in 2025. At $0.25 a banana that is about 1.4 trillion bananas, 170 for every person alive.

question: How many kilometres tall would a stack of one trillion one-dollar bills be?
explainer: A dollar bill is about 0.11 mm thick. A trillion of them is 110 million metres, about 110,000 km: more than a quarter of the way to the Moon.

question: Spending $1,000 a day, how many years would it take to get through a billion dollars?
explainer: A billion divided by $1,000 a day is a million days, which is about 2,700 years. You would have started around the founding of Rome.

question: How much does a takeaway coffee every single day add up to over 60 years?
explainer: $4 a day is $1,461 a year. Over 60 years that is about $88,000, a decent car for every decade.

question: How many Big Macs could the US federal government buy with one year's spending?
explainer: Washington spent about $6.13 trillion in fiscal 2023. At $5.69 a Big Mac that is about 1.1 trillion burgers, 130 for everyone on Earth.

question: Counting one bill a second non-stop, how many days would it take to count a million dollars in $1 bills?
explainer: There are 86,400 seconds in a day, so a million seconds is about 11.6 days of non-stop counting.

question: How much would it cost to buy every possible Powerball ticket combination?
explainer: There are 292,201,338 possible Powerball combinations. At $2 a ticket that is about $584 million, so a jackpot below that loses money even if you buy them all.

question: How many standard gold bars are stored in Fort Knox?
explainer: Fort Knox holds about 4,580 tonnes of gold, which is 4.58 million kg. Divided by 12.4 kg a bar, that is about 370,000 bars.

question: How many Olympic swimming pools would all the gold ever mined in history fill?
source_title: How much gold has been mined? (World Gold Council)
explainer: About 216,000 tonnes of gold have ever been mined. Gold is dense, 19,300 kg per m³, so that is only 11,200 m³: about four and a half Olympic pools.

question: Working full time on the US federal minimum wage, how many years would it take to earn a million dollars?
explainer: $7.25 an hour for 2,080 hours a year is $15,080 a year. A million dollars takes about 66 years, before tax.

question: How many months of Netflix could one 30-second Super Bowl ad pay for?
explainer: A 30-second Super Bowl spot cost about $7 million in 2024, and Netflix Standard was $15.49 a month: about 450,000 months, or 38,000 years of telly.

question: How much money is a one-tonne pile of US pennies worth?
explainer: A penny weighs 2.5 g, so a tonne (1,000,000 g) is 400,000 pennies, worth $4,000.

question: How many kilograms does a million dollars in $100 bills weigh?
explainer: A million dollars is 10,000 hundred-dollar bills, and each bill weighs about 1 gram: 10 kg, which fits in a backpack.

question: How many Big Macs is a year of the median US household income?
source_title: Income in the United States: 2023 (U.S. Census Bureau)
explainer: The median US household earned $80,610 in 2023. At $5.69 a Big Mac that is about 14,000 burgers, 39 a day.

question: Saving $10 every day from your 18th birthday, how much cash would you have on your 65th, with no interest?
explainer: 47 years is 17,167 days. At $10 a day that is about $172,000 under the mattress.

question: Spending $1,000 every second, how many years would it take to spend Jeff Bezos's 2025 fortune?
explainer: Forbes put Bezos at about $215 billion in 2025. At $1,000 a second that is 215 million seconds, about 6.8 years.

question: How much money, in one-dollar bills laid end to end, would it take to circle the equator?
explainer: A dollar bill is 15.6 cm long and the equator is 40,075 km, 40 million metres. That is about 260 million bills, so $260 million.

question: How much is a bathtub full of US pennies worth?
explainer: A penny is 19.05 mm across and 1.52 mm thick, about 0.43 cm³. A 300-litre tub is 300,000 cm³ and coins pack to about 60%, so about 415,000 pennies: roughly $4,200.

question: Working full time on the UK National Living Wage, how many years would it take to earn a million pounds?
source_title: National Minimum Wage and National Living Wage rates (GOV.UK)
explainer: £11.44 an hour for 37.5 hours a week is £22,300 a year. A million pounds takes about 45 years.

question: With a million dollars in a savings account, how many lattes a day could you buy on the interest alone?
explainer: 4% of a million is $40,000 a year, about $110 a day, which buys about 22 lattes a day forever.

question: How many trips to the Moon would a stack of the US national debt in one-dollar bills make?
explainer: The debt was about $36.2 trillion at the end of 2024. At 0.11 mm a bill the stack is 4 million km tall, about 10 trips to the Moon.

question: Spending a million dollars every day, how many years would it take to spend a trillion dollars?
explainer: A trillion divided by a million is a million days, which is about 2,700 years.

question: How many Big Macs could you buy for the price of one iPhone 16?
explainer: An iPhone 16 costs $799 and a Big Mac about $5.69, so about 140 burgers.
